purpose: Exact multi-seed replication of the headline Qwen fixed-spectrum result
primary_contrast: source_max minus distractor_control margin, averaged within seed over all four lengths
test: two-sided exact sign-flip test over six seed means
success_rule: all six seed means positive and exact two-sided p < 0.05
notes: Every seed reruns the same source-mass calibration rule. Layers and heads may differ because circuit selection is part of the frozen protocol; precision, prompt format, lengths, sample counts, and contrast are identical.
